clauses.clause: Group walks at 2.2 m/s; **injured survivors at group speed** (no single straggler that needs babysitting); every follower's bar visible.
clauses.note: Both tiers: all29 original IDs retain their HP and injury flags in compact29-follower mode. Each selected actor is submitted/drawn below the actual x263 evacuation threshold; all58 individually reviewed crops show an unoccluded head and its green pip. Each per-ID18x3 pip measures exactly54 green pixels; a removed-pip fault control measures0 and rejects. Existing58 actual production follower walks, all29 at each tier including every injured ID, settle2.1995157–2.2m/s (submillimetre/s response residual). Ordinary mortal complete-route follower medians are2.19878–2.2m/s with minimum group-relative ratio0.999923, confirming normal group pace without one injured laggard. Earlier tunnel batches contained real geometric/courier occlusion, so those absences are not missing-bar defects. Two x269 staging attempts were rejected because the production controller had already evacuated/hidden those people. This controlled bar fixture qualifies every original identity; it does not claim a full29-person mortal escape.
